prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: Full flight!! Flying on #Thanksgiving isn't as fun as it used to be #empty seats
Delta: Understood. Thanks for flying with us, Wendy! Happy Travels.  *AJZ

Customer: This is not the  I’m used to... I choose to stand by you but I’m being let down as of late... #youknowbetter #notworththeextramoney #dirtyplanes https://t.co/FvD8jLyKod
Delta: Hello, David. Very sorry to see. We must do better. Did you inform our in-flight team about this?  *ARD

Customer: since I am going to need every MQD to qualify next year under the new Diamond requirements, if I book my January travel now, will those MQD count for when the trip happens? Or do they count now? #HelpMeStayDiamond
Delta: 2018 Medallion Status is earned through flight and spending activity for the 2017 calendar year (January 1, 2017 to December 31, 2017); 2018 Status is valid from the day it is earned until January 31, 2019. Hope this helps. *HDV

Customer: have reservation using points, traveler is my daughter does she have to show the credit card used at her departure airport. i used my cc to pay the fee
Delta: Hi there, I can look into this for you. Can you please provide me your confirmation code via this link? *TRR https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: praise):
"""used to be terrified of flying before I met you, now I count down the hours til I see you again #jfk #terminal4 https://t.co/ZoSGgq0HgH"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Thank you for sharing your story! We're delighted to hear flying feels like a countdown now. Safe travels on your next adventure!
